latest.title: Bringing Snowflake Cortex Agents into Amazon QuickSuite with MCP
latest.description: In this post, we'll show you how to connect Snowflake Cortex agents directly to Amazon QuickSuite using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling business users to perform natural language querying with text-to-SQL and receive real-time answers from your Snowflake data warehouse without any data movement or engineering bottlenecks.

latest.title: Claude Code Beyond Anthropic: Lessons from Routing 15 Bedrock Models Through a Gateway
latest.description: Routing Claude Code to Bedrock takes two env vars. Non-Anthropic models need a gateway. We tested 15 Bedrock models via LiteLLM: 11 worked, 4 didn't.

latest.title: O erro de tentar aprender tudo ao mesmo tempo
latest.description: Tentar aprender tudo ao mesmo tempo pode parecer produtivo, mas, na prática, é um dos maiores erros de quem está começando em tecnologia. Neste artigo, você vai entender por que isso acontece e como uma abordagem mais simples e focada pode acelerar de verdade o seu aprendizado.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.
